description: Switches off a tracked link that has already been sent. Anyone who opens it afterwards sees that it is no longer available, and the sender is emailed that somebody tried. This changes what a recipient can see. It is reversible — `revoked: false` switches the link back on — and it deletes nothing: the link, its settings and its whole reading history survive. Deleting a link is possible only on the website. A link’s settings cannot be changed after it is made, and switching one off to create a replacement carrying different settings leaves the recipient holding a dead address, so that is a swap the user agrees to explicitly rather than a way to edit a setting.

revoked.description: True (the default) switches the link off. False switches it back on.

share_id.description: The share id, the share's slug (the part after /r/ in its link), or the link itself. list_shares returns all three.

name: revoke_share
title: Switch a tracked link off
